headline: Rare earths in the Dominican Republic could be declared in 2027
summary: Energy and Mines Minister Joel Santos said the country plans to declare its first rare earth reserves in the first half of 2027. The timeline, first set for 2026, has changed several times.
why: Rare earth elements are used in electronics, batteries and defense equipment, so reserve declarations matter for mining investment and supply chains.
original_headline: Tierras raras en República Dominicana podrían declararse en 2027
